```{r setup}
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$payload_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)

esc_html <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x)) return("")
  s <- as.character(x)
  s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub('"', "&quot;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

vpro_crest_svg <- function() {
  paste0(
    '<svg class="bcgov-crest-svg" width="32" height="32" viewBox="160 120 704 784" fill="none" ',
    'xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" data-vpro-crest="topbar">',
    '<path d="M512 162L216 286V512C216 681 342 827 512 864C682 827 808 681 808 512V286Z" ',
    'fill="#1E5128" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="32" stroke-linejoin="round"/>',
    '<path d="M488 614H536L542 754Q512 764 482 754Z" fill="#FCBA19"/>',
    '<path d="M512 454L698 654Q512 618 326 654Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>',
    '<path d="M512 344L656 518Q512 488 368 518Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>',
    '<path d="M512 244L614 396Q512 372 410 396Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>',
    '</svg>'
  )

derive_bec_diag_pills <- function(vr) {
  raw_codes <- character(0L)
  if (!is.null(vr$diagnosticCodes) && length(vr$diagnosticCodes) > 0L) {
    raw_codes <- tolower(trimws(as.character(unlist(vr$diagnosticCodes))))
  } else if (!is.null(vr$diagnosis) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(vr$diagnosis)))) {
    raw_codes <- tolower(trimws(strsplit(as.character(vr$diagnosis), "[,\\s]+")[[1L]]))
  } else {
    cp <- as.numeric(vr$constancyPct)
    mc <- as.numeric(vr$meanCover)
    if (!is.na(cp) && !is.na(mc)) {
      if (cp >= 80.0 && mc >= 10.0) {
        raw_codes <- c("cd")
      } else if (cp >= 60.0) {
        raw_codes <- c("c")
      } else if (cp >= 40.0 || mc >= 5.0) {
        raw_codes <- c("ic")
      }
    }
  }
  valid <- raw_codes[raw_codes %in% c("d", "dd", "cd", "c", "ic")]
  if (length(valid) == 0L) return('<span class="diag-empty">&mdash;</span>')
  pills <- vapply(valid, function(cd) {
    sprintf('<span class="diag-pill diag-pill-%s">%s</span>', cd, cd)
  }, character(1L))
  paste(pills, collapse = " ")
}

render_edatopic_svg <- function(grid_obj, title_text, is_actual = FALSE) {
  snrs <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
  rows <- if (is_actual) {
    c("0", "0.5", "1", "1.5", "2", "2.5", "3", "3.5", "4", "4.5", "5", "5.5", "6", "6.5", "7", "7.5", "8")
  } else {
    c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8")
  }
  cell_w <- 48
  cell_h <- if (is_actual) 19 else 30
  pad_l <- 64
  pad_t <- 60
  w <- pad_l + length(snrs) * cell_w + 18
  grid_bottom <- pad_t + length(rows) * cell_h
  h <- grid_bottom + 32
  smr_axis_label <- if (is_actual) "Actual SMR (aSMR)" else "Relative SMR (rSMR)"
  axis_mid_y <- pad_t + (length(rows) * cell_h) / 2.0
  grid_mid_x <- pad_l + (length(snrs) * cell_w) / 2.0

  cells_list <- if (!is.null(grid_obj) && !is.null(grid_obj$cells)) grid_obj$cells else list()
  max_cnt <- 1L
  cell_map <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
  for (c_item in cells_list) {
    key <- paste0(as.character(c_item$moisture), "|", toupper(as.character(c_item$nutrient)))
    cnt <- as.integer(c_item$count)
    if (cnt > max_cnt) max_cnt <- cnt
    assign(key, c_item, envir = cell_map)
  }

  parts <- c(
    sprintf(
      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" width="%d" height="%d" style="max-width:100%%;height:auto;display:block;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;" role="img" aria-label="%s">',
      w, h, w, h, esc_html(title_text)
    ),
    sprintf('<rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="%d" height="%d" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D5DB" rx="6"/>', w - 1L, h - 1L),
    sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', w / 2.0, esc_html(title_text)),
    sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" fill="#4B5563">Soil Nutrient Regime (SNR)</text>', grid_mid_x),
    sprintf('<text x="16" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 16 %.1f)" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" fill="#4B5563">%s</text>', axis_mid_y, axis_mid_y, smr_axis_label)
  )

  for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
    cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w + (cell_w / 2.0)
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="10.5" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', cx, snrs[[ci]]))
  }

  for (ri in seq_along(rows)) {
    ry <- pad_t + (ri - 1L) * cell_h
    r_lbl <- rows[[ri]]
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%.1f" text-anchor="end" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" fill="#313132">%s</text>', pad_l - 7L, ry + (cell_h * 0.68), r_lbl))
    for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
      cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w
      key <- paste0(r_lbl, "|", snrs[[ci]])
      cnt <- 0L
      if (exists(key, envir = cell_map, inherits = FALSE)) {
        cnt <- as.integer(get(key, envir = cell_map)$count)
      }
      fill <- "#F8FAFB"
      txt_col <- "#4B5563"
      is_core <- FALSE
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        ratio <- cnt / max_cnt
        if (ratio >= 0.70) {
          fill <- "#003366"
          txt_col <- "#FFFFFF"
          is_core <- TRUE
        } else if (ratio >= 0.35) {
          fill <- "#1E5128"
          txt_col <- "#FFFFFF"
        } else {
          fill <- "#E9F1EB"
          txt_col <- "#1E5128"
        }
      }
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="%d" height="%d" fill="%s" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="0.85"/>', cx, ry, cell_w, cell_h, fill))
      if (is_core) {
        parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<rect x="%.1f" y="%.1f" width="%.1f" height="%.1f" fill="none" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="1.35" rx="1"/>', cx + 1.4, ry + 1.4, cell_w - 2.8, cell_h - 2.8))
      }
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="%s">%d</text>', cx + (cell_w / 2.0), ry + (cell_h * 0.68), txt_col, cnt))
      }
    }
  }

  leg_y <- grid_bottom + 11L
  parts <- c(
    parts,
    sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="10" height="10" fill="#E9F1EB" stroke="#B7CFC0" stroke-width="0.9"/>', pad_l, leg_y),
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%d" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="8.5" fill="#313132">Low (&lt;35%%)</text>', pad_l + 13L, leg_y + 8L),
    sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="10" height="10" fill="#1E5128" stroke="#1E5128" stroke-width="0.9"/>', pad_l + 80L, leg_y),
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%d" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="8.5" fill="#313132">Mod (35-69%%)</text>', pad_l + 93L, leg_y + 8L),
    sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="10" height="10" fill="#003366" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="1.2"/>', pad_l + 172L, leg_y),
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%d" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="8.5" fill="#313132">Core (&ge;70%%)</text>', pad_l + 185L, leg_y + 8L),
    "</svg>"
  )
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}

render_aspect_rose_svg <- function(sectors_list) {
  labels <- c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  counts <- integer(8L)
  if (!is.null(sectors_list)) {
    for (s_item in sectors_list) {
      idx <- match(toupper(as.character(s_item$sector)), labels)
      if (!is.na(idx)) counts[[idx]] <- as.integer(s_item$count)
    }
  }
  max_c <- max(1L, counts)
  cx <- 130
  cy <- 136
  r_max <- 78

  parts <- c(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 260 262" width="260" height="262" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;" role="img" aria-label="Aspect Rose Diagram">',
    '<rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="259" height="261" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D5DB" rx="6"/>',
    '<text x="130" y="19" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">Aspect Rose (8-Sector)</text>',
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%.1f" fill="none" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>', cx, cy, r_max * 0.33),
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%.1f" fill="none" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>', cx, cy, r_max * 0.66),
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%d" fill="none" stroke="#9CA3AF" stroke-width="1"/>', cx, cy, r_max),
    sprintf('<line x1="%d" y1="%d" x2="%d" y2="%d" stroke="#E2E8F0"/>', cx - r_max, cy, cx + r_max, cy),
    sprintf('<line x1="%d" y1="%d" x2="%d" y2="%d" stroke="#E2E8F0"/>', cx, cy - r_max, cx, cy + r_max)
  )

  for (i in seq_len(8L)) {
    ang_deg <- (i - 1L) * 45.0 - 90.0
    a1 <- (ang_deg - 18.0) * pi / 180.0
    a2 <- (ang_deg + 18.0) * pi / 180.0
    ratio <- counts[[i]] / max_c
    rad <- if (counts[[i]] > 0L) max(10.0, ratio * r_max) else 0.0
    if (rad > 0.0) {
      x1 <- cx + rad * cos(a1)
      y1 <- cy + rad * sin(a1)
      x2 <- cx + rad * cos(a2)
      y2 <- cy + rad * sin(a2)
      wedge_fill <- if (ratio >= 0.65) "#003366" else "#1E5128"
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf(
        '<path d="M %d %d L %.1f %.1f A %.1f %.1f 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Z" fill="%s" fill-opacity="0.90" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="1.3"/>',
        cx, cy, x1, y1, rad, rad, x2, y2, wedge_fill
      ))
    }
    am <- ang_deg * pi / 180.0
    lx <- cx + (r_max + 18.0) * cos(am)
    ly <- cy + (r_max + 18.0) * sin(am) + 3.5
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#313132">%s (%d)</text>', lx, ly, labels[[i]], counts[[i]]))
  }
  parts <- c(
    parts,
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="3" fill="#FCBA19" stroke="#003366" stroke-width="1.1"/>', cx, cy),
    "</svg>"
  )
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}

render_boxplot_svg <- function(box_obj, title_text, unit_suffix) {
  parts <- c(
    sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 290 120" width="290" height="120" style="max-width:100%%;height:auto;display:block;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;" role="img" aria-label="%s">', esc_html(title_text)),
    '<rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="289" height="119" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D5DB" rx="6"/>',
    sprintf('<text x="145" y="19" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', esc_html(title_text))
  )
  if (is.null(box_obj) || is.null(box_obj$n) || as.integer(box_obj$n) == 0L) {
    parts <- c(parts, '<text x="145" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10.5" fill="#4B5563">No measured values in scope</text></svg>')
    return(paste(parts, collapse = "\n"))
  }
  mn <- as.numeric(box_obj$min)
  q1 <- as.numeric(box_obj$q1)
  md <- as.numeric(box_obj$median)
  q3 <- as.numeric(box_obj$q3)
  mx <- as.numeric(box_obj$max)
  span <- max(1e-6, mx - mn)
  scale_x <- function(v) 28.0 + ((v - mn) / span) * 234.0

  x_mn <- scale_x(mn)
  x_q1 <- scale_x(q1)
  x_md <- scale_x(md)
  x_q3 <- scale_x(q3)
  x_mx <- scale_x(mx)

  parts <- c(parts,
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="58" x2="%.1f" y2="58" stroke="#003366" stroke-width="2"/>', x_mn, x_mx),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="44" x2="%.1f" y2="72" stroke="#003366" stroke-width="2"/>', x_mn, x_mn),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="44" x2="%.1f" y2="72" stroke="#003366" stroke-width="2"/>', x_mx, x_mx),
    sprintf('<rect x="%.1f" y="40" width="%.1f" height="36" fill="#E9F1EB" stroke="#1E5128" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/>', x_q1, max(3.5, x_q3 - x_q1)),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="38" x2="%.1f" y2="78" stroke="#002244" stroke-width="4.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>', x_md, x_md),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="38" x2="%.1f" y2="78" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>', x_md, x_md),
    sprintf('<text x="145" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" fill="#313132">n=%d | Min %.1f%s | Med %.1f%s | Max %.1f%s</text>',
            as.integer(box_obj$n), mn, unit_suffix, md, unit_suffix, mx, unit_suffix),
    '</svg>'
  )
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{=html}
    background: var(--vpro-navy);
    color: var(--vpro-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--vpro-navy-dark);
  }

  .diag-pill-c {
    background: var(--vpro-navy-tint);
    color: var(--vpro-navy);
    border: 1px solid #9EC3E6;
  }

  .diag-pill-ic {
    background: var(--vpro-canvas);
    color: var(--vpro-ink);
    border: 1px solid var(--vpro-border-strong);
  }

  .diag-empty {
    color: var(--vpro-ink-secondary);
  }

  .table-scroll {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    border: 1px solid var(--vpro-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  table.bec-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 560px;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    background: var(--vpro-surface);
  }

  table.bec-table th {
    background: var(--vpro-navy);
    color: var(--vpro-surface);
    text-align: left;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--vpro-gold);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  table.bec-table th.num-col,
  table.bec-table td.num-col {
    text-align: right;
    font-family: var(--vpro-font-mono);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  table.bec-table td {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vpro-border);
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

  table.bec-table tbody tr:last-child td {
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  table.bec-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {
    background: var(--vpro-surface-subtle);
  }

  .spp-code {
    font-family: var(--vpro-font-mono);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--vpro-navy);
    background: var(--vpro-navy-tint);
    padding: 1px 5px;
    border-radius: 3px;
  }

  .constancy-roman {
    font-family: var(--vpro-font-mono);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--vpro-forest);
  }

  .sci-name {
    font-style: italic;
  }

  .guide-footer {
    max-width: 1160px;
    margin: 0 auto 24px;
    padding: 10px clamp(12px, 3vw, 24px) 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--vpro-border);
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--vpro-ink-secondary);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 6px 16px;
  }

  @page {
    size: auto;
    margin: 14mm 12mm;
  }

  @media print {
    html, body {
      background: #FFFFFF;
      -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
      print-color-adjust: exact;
    }
    .guide-container {
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 8px 0;
    }
    .bcgov-banner,
    .summary-card,
    .svg-panel,
    svg {
      break-inside: avoid;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
    }
    .table-scroll {
      overflow-x: visible;
    }
    table.bec-table {
      min-width: 0;
    }
  }
</style>
```

```{r render_body, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    '<header class="bcgov-banner"><div class="bcgov-banner-inner">',
    '<span class="bcgov-crest-wrap">%s</span>',
    '<div class="bcgov-banner-copy">',
    '<div class="bcgov-banner-top"><span class="bec-pill">BEC Program</span>',
    '<span class="ministry-attr">B.C. Ministry of Forests &mdash; Research Branch</span></div>',
    '<h1>%s</h1>',
    '<div class="subtitle">Project: <span class="mono">%s</span> | BGC: <span class="mono">%s</span> | Sampled Plots: <span class="mono">%d</span> | Generated: <span class="mono">%s</span></div>',
    '</div></div></header>'
  ),
  vpro_crest_svg(),
  esc_html(payload$title),
  esc_html(payload$project),
  esc_html(payload$bgcLabel),
  as.integer(payload$plotCount),
  esc_html(payload$generatedAt)
))

cat('<main class="guide-container">')

# Concept & Climate Strip Section
cat('<section class="card summary-card"><h2>Ecological Concept &amp; Site Diagnosis</h2>')
cat(sprintf('<p class="concept-text">%s</p>', gsub("\n", "<br/>", esc_html(payload$conceptNotes))))
cat('<div class="kpi-strip">')
cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box kpi-forest"><div class="kpi-label">Target Unit</div><div class="kpi-val">%s</div></div>', esc_html(payload$targetUnit)))
cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box kpi-forest"><div class="kpi-label">BGC Subzone</div><div class="kpi-val">%s</div></div>', esc_html(payload$bgcLabel)))
cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">Sampled Plots</div><div class="kpi-val">%d</div></div>', as.integer(payload$plotCount)))
if (!is.null(payload$climateSummary)) {
  cs <- payload$climateSummary
  cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">MAT / MAP</div><div class="kpi-val">%.1f &deg;C / %.0f mm</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanMat), as.numeric(cs$meanMap)))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">MSP / PAS</div><div class="kpi-val">%.0f / %.0f mm</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanMsp), as.numeric(cs$meanPas)))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">Mean CMD</div><div class="kpi-val">%.0f mm</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanCmd)))
  if (!is.null(cs$meanDd5) && !is.na(as.numeric(cs$meanDd5))) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">Mean DD5</div><div class="kpi-val">%.0f</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanDd5)))
  }
}
cat('</div></section>')

# Dual Edatopic Grids + Topographic Diagrams
cat('<section class="card summary-card"><h2>Dual Edatopic Grids (Relative rSMR vs Actual aSMR) &amp; Topographic Position</h2><div class="grid-row">')
cat('<div class="svg-panel">', render_edatopic_svg(payload$relativeGrid, "Relative Edatopic Grid (rSMR x rSNR)", FALSE), '</div>')
cat('<div class="svg-panel">', render_edatopic_svg(payload$actualGrid, "Actual Edatopic Grid (aSMR x rSNR)", TRUE), '</div>')
cat('<div class="svg-panel">', render_aspect_rose_svg(payload$aspectRose), '</div>')
cat('<div class="boxplot-stack">')
cat('<div class="svg-panel">', render_boxplot_svg(payload$elevationStats, "Elevation Distribution", " m"), '</div>')
cat('<div class="svg-panel">', render_boxplot_svg(payload$slopeStats, "Slope Gradient Distribution", "%"), '</div>')
cat('</div></div></section>')

# Vegetation Summary Table
cat('<section class="card summary-card"><h2>Characteristic Vegetation Summary</h2>')
veg_rows <- if (!is.null(payload$vegetationTable)) payload$vegetationTable else list()
if (length(veg_rows) == 0L) {
  cat('<p class="concept-text">No vegetation records met the summary threshold.</p>')
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="diag-legend"><strong>BEC Diagnostic &amp; Prominence Classes:</strong>',
    '<span><span class="diag-pill diag-pill-d">d</span> Differential</span>',
    '<span><span class="diag-pill diag-pill-dd">dd</span> Dominant Differential</span>',
    '<span><span class="diag-pill diag-pill-cd">cd</span> Constant Dominant (&ge;80%, &ge;10% cov)</span>',
    '<span><span class="diag-pill diag-pill-c">c</span> Constant (&ge;60%)</span>',
    '<span><span class="diag-pill diag-pill-ic">ic</span> Important Companion</span>',
    '</div>'
  ))
  cat('<div class="table-scroll"><table class="bec-table"><thead><tr><th>Stratum</th><th>Code</th><th>Scientific Name</th><th>Common Name</th><th class="num-col">Constancy (%)</th><th>Class</th><th>BEC Diag</th><th class="num-col">Mean Cover (%)</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
  for (vr in veg_rows) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<tr><td>%s</td><td><span class="spp-code">%s</span></td><td class="sci-name">%s</td><td>%s</td><td class="num-col">%.1f</td><td><span class="constancy-roman">%s</span></td><td>%s</td><td class="num-col">%.2f</td></tr>',
      esc_html(vr$layer),
      esc_html(vr$species),
      esc_html(vr$scientificName),
      esc_html(vr$englishName),
      as.numeric(vr$constancyPct),
      esc_html(vr$constancyClass),
      derive_bec_diag_pills(vr),
      as.numeric(vr$meanCover)
    ))
  }
  cat('</tbody></table></div>')
}
cat('</section></main>')
```
